instructions.title: v35 knee cap — matched pair assembly
instructions.text: Print the v35 cap and femur together as a matched pair. Slide ordinary M3 hex nuts into the femur end slots, seat the cap, and insert two M3x8 socket-head screws from the cap face. Nuts bear against 3 mm femur roofs under screw tension. To service, remove both screws and withdraw the cap/servo through the open face. Test one printed pair; physical fit and loaded strength/fatigue are unverified. Femur-to-hip C web interface remains six screws into short M3 insert pockets only 3.1 mm deep; the user's 5.7 mm inserts will not fit.
